messages:
Maya: quick design check — added an inline diagnostics drawer to the Private Setup network step. It surfaces a short probe summary + two CTAs. Thoughts?
Tom: I like the drawer instead of a full modal. Does it show next steps when the probe fails? :thinking:
Maya: Yes — two CTAs: "Open diagnostic" (full view) and "See remediation steps" (inline). Copy is intentionally compact rn.
Sam: can we ensure keyboard focus moves into the drawer on open? a11y lab flagged focus trapping issues before.
Julie: +1 on focus. Also need aria-live for progress and final status so screen readers get updates.
Tom: microcopy note: current heading "Confirm network access" is vague. suggest: "Check connectivity to Redwood services (egress TCP 443)" or similar.
Maya: good call — maybe: "Allow outbound traffic to Redwood (TCP 443)" — short, actioned. keep detailed rules in advanced view.
Sam: For advanced users, show raw probe logs in an expandable block. sample snippet: 
```
curl -v https://api.redwood.ai:443
TCP handshake 200ms
TLS ok
POST 200
```
Julie: accessibility: the status pills (green/orange/red) fail contrast at small sizes — add icons + explicit labels for colorblind users.
Maya: agreed. we'll add icon + sr-only text. update tooltip copy from "What does this check?" -> "What this test verifies" (shorter).
Tom: can remediation be collapsed into inline steps with a single "copy config" button for ops teams? saves clicks.
Sam: also add "retry last probe" keyboard shortcut (when drawer focused press R) — mention in help.
Julie: ux nit: primary button says "Run checks" but action can block; avoid long labels. prefer short label + small hint text "(may take ~30s)" below for screen readers.
Maya: good pattern — short label + status hint via aria-live. i'll update prototype.
deploy-bot: deploy succeeded: wireframe updated -> /design/hosting/wizard/diagnostics-v1.png
Tom: i'll run a copy pass and leave comments in Figma. who wants the small a11y tasks this sprint?
Sam: i'll take focus management + aria-live.
Julie: i'll handle contrast + iconography.
Maya: amazing — thanks. i'll update the drawer prototype with keyboard flow, advanced logs accordion, and the compact remediation layout. :raised_hands:
